Q1.QUESTION: Is this tool free?
Q1.ANSWER: Yes! We offer a generous free tier that allows you to analyze your resume and get basic insights.

Q2.QUESTION: Do you store my data?
Q2.ANSWER: Your privacy is our top priority. Your API key is stored locally on your device, and resume data is only used for the duration of the analysis.

Q3.QUESTION: Can I use my own API Key?
Q3.ANSWER: Absolutely. You can plug in your own Google Gemini API key in the settings menu for unlimited personal analysis.

Q4.QUESTION: Does it work for all industries?
Q4.ANSWER: Yes, our AI is trained on millions of job descriptions across all major industries, from Tech and Finance to Healthcare and Creative Arts.
